The original yes/no problem remains open. The strongest frozen result is an independently audited partial theorem: every hypothetical eleven-point equilateral set in l1^5 has at least 19 positive consecutive coordinate gaps, hence at least 24 total coordinate levels. A separate exact finite certificate proves maximum 10 only in the box {0,1,2,3,4}^5.
